title: Right-derived connecting maps agree with the derived triangle
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], let $\mathcal A$ have enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be left exact and additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For a short exact sequence $S:0\to A\to B\to C\to0$, define the connecting maps on the right derived functors $R^nv$ by a horseshoe injective resolution of $S$ [lem-weil-pbc-horseshoe-delta-functor] and the long exact cohomology sequence of the resulting short exact sequence of complexes [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact]. Under the canonical identifications $R^nv(X)\cong H^n(Rv(X[0]))$ [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], these connecting maps are the homology connecting maps [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] of the distinguished triangle [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] obtained by applying the right derived functor $Rv$ (an exact functor of triangulated categories) to the distinguished triangle $A[0]\to B[0]\to C[0]\to A[0][1]$ of $S$ [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle].

proof.text: Use exists_horseshoe_rightDerived_deltaFunctor v to obtain G, hF and the comparison with every compatible horseshoe. This supplies the entire first conjunct unchanged.

For each S and n choose horseshoe resolutions using exists_horseshoe_resolutions. Apply the comparison already supplied by G to obtain exactness hvH of the termwise image and its snake-boundary formula.

The proved natComplex_boundary_derived gives short exactness of the extended image and identifies its derived triangle boundary with hvH.delta. The fixed-horseshoe comparison supplies a triangle morphism whose endpoint homology maps are the prescribed canonical isomorphisms.

Apply Functor.homologySequenceδ_naturality to that actual triangle morphism. Postcompose by the endpoint extension homology isomorphism and substitute the endpoint identities and the proved boundary formula. Rewrite G.delta by its horseshoe equation. Cancel the two target endpoint isomorphisms and cancel theta at the source by its inverse. Associativity and inverse/hom identities give exactly the second conjunct, including hF transports.

lean.statement: theorem rightDerived_triangle_connecting {A : Type u₁} {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A] [EnoughInjectives A] [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} B] (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits v] : ∃ (G : CohomologicalDeltaFunctor A B) (hF : G.F = (fun n : ℕ ↦ v.rightDerived n)), (∀ (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact) (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃) (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex) (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0) (_hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ A).map S.f ≫ IB.ι) (_hιB : IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ A).map S.g ≫ IC.ι) (_hH : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map (HomologicalComplex.eval A (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact), ∃ hvH : ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map (v.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ))).ShortExact, ∀ n : ℕ, G.delta S hS n ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ (F (n + 1)).obj S.X₁) hF) = eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ (F n).obj S.X₃) hF) ≫ (IC.isoRightDerivedObj v n).hom ≫ hvH.δ n (n + 1) rfl ≫ (IA.isoRightDerivedObj v (n + 1)).inv) ∧ (∀ (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ), G.delta S hS n ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ (F (n + 1)).obj S.X₁) hF) ≫ (v.homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso S.X₁ (n + 1)).inv = eqToHom (congrArg (fun F ↦ (F n).obj S.X₃) hF) ≫ (v.homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso S.X₃ n).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ ((v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).mapTriangle.obj hS.singleTrianglePlus) (n : ℤ) (n + 1) (by omega))
